blocages: https://www.umoncton.ca/repertoire/programmes (Répertoire 2026-2027) and the campus 'programmes' pages render their program dropdown by script (empty to WebFetch, not a block); replaced by the official 'Feuilles de route' page (one link per program to the répertoire PDF) and the official Formation continue part-time program list (certificates)

attendu.comment: Baccalaureat: 107 first-cycle entries of the official 'Feuilles de route' listing (each linking to its répertoire PDF; minors listed separately and not counted) + 2 bachelor's listed only in the Formation continue list (B.Éd. primaire, whose roadmap is 'à venir', and Baccalauréat appliqué en technologie, information et leadership). Unit = répertoire program; co-op, profil (régulier/avec distinction/appliqué/mixte/littérature/linguistique), accelerated and admission-route variants merged. Certificat: the 12 first-cycle certificates of the official Formation continue part-time program list (the répertoire dropdown was not readable).
